changes: pads: none → pads (groove_mm 0, lip_mm 0, pad_angle_deg 30, pad_tpu_mm 1.5, reach_mm 0, width_mm 12)
why: At 30 deg the moving face is roughly -10 deg at the banana's 40-45 mm (pushing up slightly, held by mu 0.9) instead of about -20 deg, and the heel sticks out less at the open pose. At 73 mm (gelatin) the face is about +15 deg with the fingertip around +9 mm, below the top at +15, so it holds by friction. At 85 mm the fingertip drops by about 6 mm to about +17, borderline for tuna (top +17). Cheaper moves are exhausted: 9 trials at 39.6-45 deg with widths of 8-17 mm, reach of 0-6 mm and a 0.76 mm TPU skin all lost the banana in the same way. Width 12 stays above the 9.3 mm that lost the potted meat can. A 30 deg wedge makes the closed heel smaller than the 45 deg one, so the 1.5 mm TPU skin should not cause the pad interference that grooves did.
